हट् {c1c} P. (हटति, हटित) To shine,
be bright.

हट्टः [हट्-ट टस्य नेत्वम्] A
market, a fair.
--Comp.
--चोरकः a thief
who steals from fairs and markets.
--विलासिनी {1} a wanton woman,
prostitute, common woman. {2}
a sort of perfume. {3} turmeric.
हट्टी A small market or fair.

हाटक a. (की f.) Golden.
--कं
1
Gold.
--2 The thorn-apple.
--Comp.
--गिरिः the mountain Meru.
